E3504

Build action `{action}` asks for ungranted `{right}` authority.

What

Build action `{action}` asks for ungranted `{right}` authority.

Why

Source declaration makes authority auditable but does not grant it. Invocation, package, and workspace policy cap ambient effects independently.

Fix

Pass the named `--allow-<effect>` flag for a one-file build, or grant the effect in package/workspace policy.
